accountMissingBody: This payee came from your setup chat without account details. Kassa will not pay it until its account details are added and verified.

add.coolingNote: A new or changed payee cools down for 24 hours before you can pay it.

coolingRule: You can pay this payee once the 24 hours are over.
explainerBody: Changing a payee's account details creates a new payee. A changed account is treated as a brand-new payee that cools down for 24 hours before it can be paid.
newPayeeExplainer: This is a new payee. It cools down for 24 hours before any payment can go to it.
notFound: This payee could not be found.
title: Payees

IBAN.hint: Within Europe (SEPA) the name and IBAN are all a bank needs. Spaces are fine.

CN_ALIPAY.hint: Paid straight to their Alipay balance, in CNY. Use the email or phone number on their Alipay account.

CN_UNIONPAY.hint: Paid to the bank account behind their UnionPay debit card, in CNY.

US_ACH.hint: An ACH transfer needs the 9-digit routing number and the account number. Both are printed on a US check.

OTHER.hint: A merchant ID or an account Kassa can't check, for QR handoffs. Bank transfers can't reach it.
